camel_example: aliyun aidge DocumentTranslate --region cn-hangzhou --FileType PDF --TargetLanguage en --Url 'https://aib-innovation-oss.oss-accelerate.aliyuncs.com/AI_Business/38dao/testdemo.pdf?Expires=3356578313&OSSAccessKeyId=REDACTED_ACCESS_KEY_ID&Signature=REDACTED_SIGNATURE' --version 2026-04-28 --method POST --force
description_en: Translates documents across more than 150 languages and provides pivot translation capabilities with up to thousands of pivot combinations. Supports multi-scenario, multi-page, and high-complexity document translation, but does not currently support scanned documents. Excels in the following aspects: - Content accuracy: translation accuracy, and accuracy of parameters and units. - Structural integrity: overall layout continuity, and restoration of page margins and layouts
description_zh:
专为文档翻译研发，支持150多个语言的翻译，并提供了桥接翻译能力，多达数千种桥接组合。满足多场景&多页数&高复杂度文档翻译，暂不支持扫描件。
在以下方面表现出色：
· 内容准确性：翻译准确性，参数与单位准确性
· 结构合理性：整体排版连续性，页面边距与布局还原性

name: DocumentTranslate

parameters.help_en: The OSS URL path of the document to be translated
parameters.help_zh: 待翻译文档的OSS URL路径
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The target language. The language code uses the two-letter representation of the ISO 639-1 standard
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en:
The supported document types: PDF and word.  
Supported size limits:  
Word: 200 MB or 100 pages. 
PDF: 200 MB or 100 pages.  
Maximum size of a single file: 200 MB
parameters.help_zh: 支持PDF，WORD，EXCEL三种格式，建议入参时使用大写格式
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intervention glossary. Specify this parameter when the intervention feature is required. Supports custom translation results, including do-not-translate (ABC-ABC), specified translation (ABC-DEF), and no translation (ABC-null). This is commonly used in scenarios such as brand word protection
parameters.help_zh:
● 需要干预功能时填写干预词表 ID   
● 支持自定义翻译结果，包含   
○ 不被翻译（ABC-ABC）；   
○ 指定翻译（ABC-DEF）；   
○ 不翻译（ABC-空值）
常用于品牌词保护等场景   
示例值："glossary_1"
parameters.name: glossary
